exposure: Progesterone level on the day after hCG injection: < 2.5 ng/ml, 2.5-3.5 ng/ml, 3.5-4.5 ng/ml, 4.5-5.5 ng/ml, >=5.5 ng/ml
Progesterone levels on the day after hCG injection
cohort: 781 women who underwent IVF-ET between August 2020 and December 2021 with progesterone levels <1.5ng/ml on the day of hCG injection.
finding: High progesterone levels on the day after hCG injection did not affect clinical pregnancy outcomes in women undergoing IVF-ET.
